results.title: Counter-speech generation for homophobic and transphobic social ...
results.content: *   We developed a manually annotated seed dataset of counter speech responses in Malayalam specifically targeting transphobic and homophobic hate speech, one of the first of its kind for this under-resourced language. Our work aims to address this by developing a Malayalam dataset and employing human-in-the-loop techniques and retrieval-augmented generation enhanced by REFINE to generate effective counter-narratives against homophobic and transphobic speech. End-to-end workflow of the dataset expansion process leveraging Gen AI and human-in-the-loop validation for generating high-quality pairs of homophobic/transphobic content and corresponding counter speech responses. In our context, RAG is employed to generate counter speech that is polite, non-aggressive, and well-informed in response to homophobic and transphobic content for unseen or novel hate speech instances, especially those in Malayalam or Malayalam in Latin Script. This methodology combining small-scale manual seeding, iterative expansion, ethical review, and retrieval-augmented zero-shot generation demonstrates a robust framework for creating diverse and effective counter speech in Malayalam and other under-resourced languages.
